- 租售业务：房源查询（楼盘/栋座/房号/状态）、客源查询（姓名/手机号/意向楼盘）、成交查询（合同编号/客户信息）、跟进记录、带看记录。**注意：查详情须先从列表获取ID。**

Covers five study patterns (canonical hub-first, cardiotoxicity or electrophysiology-oriented, immune-inflammatory adverse effect, organ-toxicity pathway context, translational validation) and always outputs four workload configs (Lite / Standard / Advanced / Publication+) with a recommended primary plan, dependency/evidence map, step-by-step workflow, figure plan, validation strategy, minimal executable version, publication upgrade path, verified-reference pack, and self-critical risk review.
skills.name: Single Drug Adverse Effect Pathway Anchored Network Pharmacology
